bureau: centrales privadas de información de riesgos (Equifax Infocorp, Experian, Sentinel) and the SBS Central de Riesgos
note: The Superintendencia de Banca, Seguros y AFP's letter to Congress of 11 July 2022 (Oficio 28580-2022-SBS) on Law 27489, article 10(d): a bureau may not hold or report a default once the debt has been extinguished two years, or five years have passed since its due date; a late payment the holder later pays is written as two years. Law 31944 later amended Law 27489; its text wasn't read. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: SBS, Oficio Nº 28580-2022-SBS (11 de julio de 2022)
sources.said: la información referida al incumplimiento de obligaciones de naturaleza civil, comercial o tributaria, cuando la obligación: i) se haya extinguido y hayan transcurrido 2 años desde su extinción (información positiva); o ii) hayan transcurrido 5 años desde el vencimiento de la obligación (negativa)
